profile.headline: Software Engineer at APX Data
profile.summary:
👋 Hi, I’m a Software Engineer specializing in React and TypeScript, with 5 years of professional experience, including leading frontend efforts at Elsevier and full stack at APX data .

I’ve now relocated to Ottawa, Canada, and I’m actively looking for new opportunities — locally or remote across Canada.

My focus is building fast, accessible, and user-friendly web interfaces. I love collaborating with product teams and turning complex ideas into intuitive UI.

Let’s connect if you’re hiring or just want to talk front-end, tech, or travel!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Replaced a third-party dashboard vendor with a custom internal dashboard, eliminating $10K/year in licensing costs whilst reducing reporting time by 40%.
- Migrated and restored legacy firehouse backup data into Azure SQL, enabling customers to query historical records through the modern web application.
- Contribute across the full stack to a public safety platform, building and maintaining features used by emergency service organizations.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Azure SQL · Vue.js · Express.js · CouchDB

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Led a full redesign of a high-traffic service (100K+ users/month), improving engagement by 11%.
- Partnered with designers to implement responsive UI updates.
- Created and triaged tasks for multi-developer collaboration and code refactoring.
- Mentored junior devs and streamlined their onboarding.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description:
- Spearheaded a large cross-squad codebase migration.
- Built intuitive UIs based on business requirements.
- Maintained comprehensive test coverage.

positions.title: Tech Associate
positions.description:
- Delivered a stakeholder dashboard.
- Identified and remedied 4 security risks, leading to improved system reliability.
- Implemented a robust JavaScript codebase with bug monitoring.
